 Judgment
The P.S.I., of H.A.L., Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offence punishable under section 304A of Indian Penal Code.
2. BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :
It is the case of the complainant that, accused No.1 is running a Udupi Vaibhava Hotel, near Marathahalli Bridge, HAL and accused No.2 is working as a Manager in the said Hotel.

It is further alleged that, on 06.03.2020 accused persons appointed the deceased Ganesh as server and on 15.03.2020 at about 8.45 PM, the said deceased Ganesh went in a temporary lift from ground floor to first floor in the said hotel to serve the food
, by that time, he was struck in the said temporary lift and succumbed to death due to the negligent act of accused No.1 and 2 in not making proper and safety requirements towards the said lift.

Based on the written complaint lodged by C.W.1, C.W.17 has registered the case against accused No.1 and 2 in P.S.
Crime No.101/2020 for the offence punishable under section 304A of IPC.

Investigating Officer/CW.17 investigated C.C.No.52558/2021 the matter and after completion of the investigation has submitted final report against the accused for the offence punishable under section 304A of IPC.
3.
Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above said offence alleged against the accused No.1 and 2 and registered the criminal case against them.
4. After registering the case, the accused No.1 and 2 have appeared before the court and were released on bail.

Copies of the final report and its' enclosures were furnished to them in compliance Kishan Singh vs Venkatesh And Another on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63960965/
2 of section 207 of Cr.P.C. Substance of accusation read over to the accused No.1 and 2.

5. In order to prove the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 17 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5 and closed its side.
In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused persons, recording of their statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
Heard the arguments of both parties.
Perused the materials on record.
2. What Order?

8. My findings on the above points are as under:
C.C.No.52558/2021 Point No.1 : In the Negative.
 Point No.2 : As per the final order  for the following;
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :-
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has to establish that, due to the negligent act of the accused persons in not providing proper and safety measures with regard to the lift, the deceased was succumbed to death.
10.

In order to prove the above said allegations, the prosecution has examined CW.1,
father of deceased Ganesh by name Kishan Singh, wherein, he has not supported the case of the prosecution.
The learned APP appearing for the state has treated him as hostile and fully cross examined him, wherein, nothing was elicited from him in order to prove the guilt of the accused persons.

On perusal of the cross examination of Kishan Singh vs Venkatesh And Another on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63960965/
3 PW.1, he has categorically admitted that, he has compromised the matter with the accused persons.

sentences.text: On perusal of the materials on record, as the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused persons.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused persons.
Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused persons and they are entitled for acquittal.
Hence, the Point No.1 is answered in the "Negative".
12. Point No.2:-

In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER
Acting under section 255(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 and 2 are acquitted of the offence punishable under section 304A of Indian Penal Code.
The Bail bond and surety bond of the accused persons shall be in force for the period of 6 months and C.C.No.52558/2021 thereafter it shall be canceled without further orders.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer and typed by her, corrected by me and then signed and pronounced in the Open Court on this date the 05 th day of June, 2025.)
